Title: Full payment with loyalty points
Preconditions: Customer sara.martinez@nimbuscart.test exists in staging-nimbus-3-2-6. Account points balance is 5000 ($50.00). Cart contains 3x Organic Avocados ($7.50); 1x Almond Milk ($17.00); 1x Sourdough Bread ($6.00). Cart subtotal is $30.50 (above the $25 minimum). Feature flag express_checkout_v3_2_6 enabled. Customer logged in on cart screen.
Steps: 1. Tap Express Checkout on the cart screen. 2. Verify subtotal shows $30.50. 3. Tap Payment options. 4. Select Pay with Loyalty Points. 5. Enter 3050 in Points to use. 6. Tap Apply. 7. Tap Confirm order.
Expected Result: Payment summary shows Order total: $0.00. Points used: 3050 displayed. Remaining loyalty balance shows 1950 points. Order confirmation shows delivery slot; order number; receipt total. Backend order record has payment_method = LOYALTY_POINTS and points_redeemed = 3050.

Title: Partial payment with points and credit card
Preconditions: Customer has 2000 points and a $30.50 basket on staging-nimbus-3-2-6.
Steps: 1. Tap Express Checkout. 2. Select Pay with Loyalty Points and enter 2000. 3. Choose credit card for the remaining amount. 4. Tap Confirm order.
Expected Result: Card charged $10.50. Points used: 2000. Remaining balance: 3000 points. Order total $0.00.

Title: Minimum basket not met before points
Preconditions: Customer has 5000 points and a $24.99 basket on staging-nimbus-3-2-6.
Steps: 1. Tap Express Checkout. 2. Attempt to select Pay with Loyalty Points.
Expected Result: Checkout blocked. Message displays the $25 minimum basket requirement.

Title: Promo code blocks loyalty points
Preconditions: Subtotal $30.50 with promo FRESH20 applied on staging-nimbus-3-2-6.
Steps: 1. Tap Express Checkout. 2. Open Payment options.
Expected Result: Pay with Loyalty Points option is disabled. Message explains points and promos cannot be combined.

Title: Points above available balance are rejected
Preconditions: Customer has 5000 points and a $30.50 basket on staging-nimbus-3-2-6.
Steps: 1. Tap Express Checkout. 2. Select Pay with Loyalty Points and enter 5001.
Expected Result: Error message shows the maximum allowed is 3050 points. Value rejected or capped.

Title: Reserve an available delivery slot
Preconditions: $30.50 basket on staging-nimbus-3-2-6. Slot Fri 20 Nov 2026 18:00-20:00 has capacity.
Steps: 1. Log in as sara.martinez@nimbuscart.test. 2. Add cart items to reach $30.50. 3. Tap Express Checkout. 4. Select the Fri 20 Nov 2026 18:00-20:00 slot. 5. Tap Confirm slot.
Expected Result: Slot reserved. Summary shows Delivery: Fri 20 Nov 2026 18:00-20:00. Slot service records reservation with status RESERVED.

Title: Slot at full capacity is unavailable
Preconditions: $30.50 basket on staging-nimbus-3-2-6. Selected slot already holds 20 orders.
Steps: 1. Open delivery slot picker. 2. Select the full slot.
Expected Result: Slot is disabled and marked full. Message shows the slot has no remaining capacity.

Title: Slot selection blocked by minimum basket
Steps: 1. Tap Express Checkout. 2. Open delivery slot picker.
Expected Result: Checkout blocked. Message displays the $25 minimum basket requirement.
